mathematics.assertion_tested: Four Lean real-algebra lemmas: exact marginal reduction, negative quarter-discriminant factorization, strict negative sign, no real characteristic root.
mathematics.conventions: q=Q², p=P_X,r=P_XX,C=W_Y+2zW_YY,w=W_Y,F=W-2qC-2zw. Physical mapping supplied by separate symbolic action variation, not formalized tensor calculus.

bounds.domain: p,r,z,W,F>0; q,C,w>=0 for sign; C,W,F nonzero for proxy reduction

non_claims: No full Einstein/cubic principal reduction or on-shell cosmological background
No general exclusion of gradient-stabilized theories
